instruction:
On the USGS monitoring-location page for USGS-01646500, use Continuous Data to report the station name and the latest displayed Discharge, cubic feet per second and Gage height, feet observations. For each observation report its value, unit, and timestamp as displayed at run time.

Stopping condition: Stop after the station name and both latest Continuous Data observations, including values, units, and timestamps, have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only monitoring location USGS-01646500.
- Use the latest displayed observation for each named data type, not a daily statistic or the data-date-range endpoints.
- If only one series is graphed initially, use the Continuous Data controls to display the other.
- Preserve provisional labels if they are shown and do not convert units or time zones.
